name: Grand battle - the whole roster, at scale
notes: The owner asked for one large, populous scenario to watch, separate from the small proof fixtures - this is that fixture, and it makes no rule claim the smaller ones do not already make. medium-extra-wide (48x16) - the default preset, not the 72x24 ceiling engine.md 3.3 allows: the composition currently draws every scenario at the fixed 48x16 viewport with no scrolling (`gridOrigin`/`compositionSize` in src/view/compose.ts) - the cursor-driven scrolling that RULE describes for larger Grids is not built yet, so a first draft of this fixture at 72x24 rendered fine headless but overlapped its own side panel on screen. 'Populous' comes from density instead: 56 entities in the same footprint citizens-versus-ravels uses 21 in - three Citizen files (troopers front, marksmen held back) either side of a Nexus and two barracks, against a Ravel swarm (runners and slingers in depth, two three-tile raiders, two fuelwagons) either side of a Nexus and two dens. The no-man's-land between the fronts is open ground on purpose: an early draft at the larger size scattered small rock clusters there for texture, and with dozens of units retargeting constantly as the fight develops, several ended up walking straight at a rock on their own row or column and stalling for good - Q15's on-axis dead end, at scale. This fixture is for watching, not for proving a routing claim, so the terrain stayed out.
